Name: (CP) Big Fish Hat
Author: wh0pp
Description:
[size=6][b]Big Fish Hat
[/b][/size][size=4]Ever felt like your head was a bit too... low? Ever wanted to show the residents of Pelican Town that you are the ultimate angler? Now you can!
[/size]
[b]Big Fish Hat[/b] adds a new, oversized fish-themed hat to Stardew Valley 1.6. It’s large, it’s flopping, and it’s a guaranteed conversation starter at the next Stardew Valley Fair.

[line][b]
Features[/b][list]
[*][b]Content Patcher Powered:[/b] No bulky frameworks or outdated code. Lightweight and fast.
[*][b]Hat Mouse Approved:[/b] Once installed, you can find this new headwear with [b]Hat Mouse[/b] at the abandoned house in Cindersap Forest.
[/list]
[b]How to Install[/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.﻿

[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

[*]Download with your favorite mod manager (ie, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]﻿) or download and unzip it into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.
[/list][list=1]

[*]Run the game using SMAPI!

[/list][b]How to Get the Hat[/b][list]
[*][b]The Honest Way:[/b] Visit the [b]Hat Mouse[/b] in south Cindersap Forest. He’ll have it in stock for [b]1,000g[/b].
[*][b]The Fast Way:[/b] Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿﻿ and search for "Big Fish Hat".
[/list]
[line][b]
Compatibility[/b][list]
[*]Created for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].
[*]Should be compatible with all other clothing and hair mods.
[*]Should work in Multiplayer (as long as all players have the mod installed).
[/list]
[i]* Special thanks to the Stardew Modding community for the constant inspiration![/i]
